stories.title: Jason Arday research cleared following Queen's University investigation
stories.summary: The 41-year-old was found dead in August following weeks of media coverage over plagiarism allegations and questions about his achievements, which he denied.

stories.title: Farrell picks side to 'back up' South Africa win
stories.summary: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell believes the Nations Championship can be good preparation for next year's World Cup.

stories.title: English and O'Connor named athletes of the year
stories.summary: European champions Mark English and Kate O'Connor are named joint winners of the Irish National Athlete of the Year award.

stories.title: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
stories.summary: The discount chain has fallen into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer.

stories.title: Smell leads police to discover 'substantial' cannabis factory
stories.summary: Two men located inside the property were arrested on suspicion of a range of drugs offences including cannabis cultivation

stories.title: Two construction companies put into administration with 31 job losses
stories.summary: Newry: The insolvency affects O'Hare & McGovern Limited and OHMG (Holdings) Limited.

stories.title: UK Town of Culture bid withdrawn in Strabane after it causes 'great division'
stories.summary: The County Tyrone town was shortlisted as one of 15 possible locations for the inaugural UK Town of Culture 2028, with the chance to win £3m.

stories.title: PSNI promises to pursue any leads uncovered during Pat Finucane inquiry
stories.summary: The Police Service of Northern Ireland has promised to pursue any investigative leads which might be uncovered by the public inquiry into the murder of Pat Finucane.

stories.title: Man accused of murdering Chloe Mitchell lied repeatedly, court hears
stories.summary: Brandon Rainey denies a charge of murder and a charge of preventing the lawful burial of Chloe Mitchell's remains.

stories.title: Sir Chris 'not playing hardball' over Stormont budget
stories.summary: The Northern Ireland Secretary says he is working all hours to try and get a resolution before Christmas.

stories.title: Sacked police officer showed 'all the hallmarks of predatory behaviour'
stories.summary: The chief executive of the Police Ombudsman's Office says the officer had shown "all the hallmarks of predatory behaviour".

stories.title: Japanese technology company to create 200 new jobs
stories.summary: NTT DATA is investing around £23m to create an Artificial Intelligence centre in Derry.
